Basic fireworks

Type: Material | Internal ID: FireworksRocket_White | Source: Hildir | Usage: Crafting, Fun | Buy: 50, Coins | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

Introduction. Basic fireworks are items which can be purchased from Hildir for 50 Coins each. This item will be in the merchant's assortment only after returning Hildir's bronze chest.

Usage. All fireworks can be used on an open fire to launch high into the air and explode. While the Basic fireworks can be used for a white explosion, it is also used to craft the other Fireworks.
